records.title: Canonical-residue stabilization is the ordinary-extraction criterion
records.statement: For compatible nested moduli, a nonnegative ordinary inverse-limit point occurs exactly when canonical least representatives eventually stabilize; a negative ordinary point occurs on the eventual maximal-block face. For nested nonempty positive survivor sets, bounded least roots are equivalent to eventual constancy and to one positive all-depth survivor.
records.scope: Abstract compatible residue chains and nested positive survivor sets; no particular Collatz-derived family is proved bounded or nonempty.
exclusions: A 2-adic completion need not be ordinary.

review.verdict: verified within packages classified VERIFIED WITH FIXES

records.title: Finite positive representatives do not force an ordinary all-depth point
records.statement: The periodic parity block 1110 has fourth iterate (27x+19)/16 and unique all-depth 2-adic realization -19/11; every finite prefix cylinder nevertheless has infinitely many positive ordinary representatives.
records.scope: Explicit parity-cylinder countermodel to compactness, drift, and finite-prefix extrapolation.
exclusions: It is not a positive orbit.

records.title: Periodic parity tails are controlled by the complete denominator
records.statement: Reviewed component arguments give the unique periodic 2-adic realizer C_w/(2^L-3^s), sign alternatives, complete-denominator ordinary divisibility, and finite-preperiod transfer. The exact combined wording, including the all-zero and fixed-block-controller boundaries, remains pending narrow independent review.
records.scope: Raw parity words, or controller symbols already proved to emit one fixed finite parity block.
exclusions: The exact synthesis is not yet independently reviewed as one theorem.

review.verdict: component statements independently reconstructed; integrated synthesis pending narrow review

records.repair_or_supersession: The synthesis does not retroactively change frozen source verdicts.

records.title: Coefficient-stopping finiteness is equivalent to escape of least all-supercritical sources
records.statement: Least all-supercritical sources escape exactly when every fixed positive integer has finite coefficient stopping time; any positive ordinary orbit with all prefixes coefficient-supercritical tends to +infinity.
records.scope: Fixed ordinary sources and canonical all-supercritical cylinders.
exclusions: Moving witnesses or a completion do not meet the fixed-source hypothesis.

review.verdict: verified with terminology and provenance fixes
